text: & not with sorrow neither with contempt concerning their first parents for forthis intent have we written these things that they may know that we knewof Christ & we had a hope of his glory many hundred years before his comeing & not only we ourselves had a hope of his glory but also all the holyprophets which were before us behold they believed in Christ & worshiped
